t: Renewable Energy Credits (RECs): What You Need To Know | EnergySage
s: May 4, 2023 - A REC is produced when a renewable energy source generates one megawatt-hour (MWh) of electricity and delivers it to the grid. For example, if a wind power facility produces 5 MWh of electricity, they have five credits to keep or sell. If you or your business buys those credits, you are buying the "renewable" aspect of the electricity from the wind farm, and you can say that 5 MWh of your electricity use came from a renewable source.
